name: Anviam 3D Coverflow Slider
author: akaundal10

sections.description:
Anviam 3D Coverflow Slider is an interactive and elegant image slider for WordPress that presents your product photos, portfolios, and featured content in a stylish 3D depth perspective deck.

Key Features

  • 3D Perspective Deck Layout: Visually rich coverflow deck effect with 3D rotational perspective.
  • Live Admin Preview: Adjust container padding, card height, width, rotation angle, and border-radius sliders in real-time within the admin area.
  • WordPress Media Library Integration: Multi-image selector directly integrated with the native WordPress Media Uploader.
  • Fully Responsive & Touch Enabled: Works seamlessly on desktop, tablet, and mobile browsers.
  • Custom Shortcode: Easy to embed anywhere using [anviam_3d_slider].
sections.installation:
1. Upload the anviam-3d-coverflow-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP file via WordPress Plugins > Add New > Upload.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to 3D Coverflow in your WordPress admin menu to configure your slides and styling settings.
  4. Insert [anviam_3d_slider] into any page, post, or widget area.
sections.faq:
How do I insert the slider into a post or page?

Simply paste the shortcode [anviam_3d_slider] into any page, post, or Gutenberg shortcode block.

Can I customize the padding and border radius?

Yes! In the admin dashboard, you can drag the interactive sliders to customize padding, card width, card height, border radius, rotation angle, and autoplay speed with live preview updates.
